text_block_list.text:
During lunch break, Daiwa Scarlet came up 
to talk to me, looking restless.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Seriously! Jeez...! This makes no sense! I 
know for a fact I didn't eat that much...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Why does my uniform feel so tight all of a 
sudden...? ...Anyway, we're doing lunch 
training, Trainer!
choice_data_list: I need to lose a little weight!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ngggh! What's your problem?! You 
carrot-brain! I'll lose weight, geez!

Pouting and fuming the whole time, Daiwa 
Scarlet worked out and successfully shed 
some weight.
